obligations.text: sync loads a developer-mode module's owned files whose disk hash differs from the baseline (or that carry a retry mark) and leaves unchanged files alone; a module not in developer mode is refused.

obligations.text: sync recompiles only what is out of date.

The update-only selection comes from the compiler flag "u" passed by Pipeline.cls::SyncCompile to LegacyCompat::UpdateSuperclassAndCompile, a provider no model represents. No rule contrasts an up-to-date item that is skipped with an out-of-date item that is recompiled.

obligations.text: Intended: sync with no module syncs every developer-mode module in dependency order (transitively).
obligations.cases: dev module ty reached from tx only through non-dev tz

obligations.cases: direct dev-dev edge (oy before ox) vs transitive edge through non-dev module (tx before ty)

obligations.text: -delete removes server items whose files were deleted (and their baselines).
obligations.cases: -delete with a deleted compilable file vs without
obligations.observation: presence of the server document; baseline row

obligations.text: -test runs the test classes that changed.
obligations.cases: changed vs unchanged test class with -test
obligations.gap: sync_baseline.rs models test-pending marks and treats the test run outcome as an input (tests_ok); no model selects which changed test classes run (Pipeline.cls::SyncRunTests via the Test processor), so a run of an unchanged class or a missed changed class satisfies every rule.

obligations.text: Without -delete, sync keeps the items whose files were deleted.
obligations.cases: deleted file with vs without -delete

obligations.text: Without -delete, sync reports how many deleted files it did not apply.

obligations.observation: the "N deleted file(s) detected but not applied" line/warning
obligations.gap: sync.rs (like Pipeline.cls:92-97) reports the count only on the nothing-to-sync path. With an edit plus a deletion and no -delete the model's not_applied is 0, but no theorem states that neighbor, and the ontology states the report unconditionally (see finding).

obligations.text: A changed module.xml is reloaded first, so files of a newly declared resource are synced as new.
obligations.cases: manifest adding SyncE.PKG vs unchanged manifest
obligations.observation: new resource file loaded and counted as updated

obligations.text: Within the scanned folders sync finds files at any depth and any extension case, except under .git, __pycache__ and node_modules.

obligations.text: A changed file sync cannot read fails the sync, and the next sync retries it.
obligations.cases: unreadable changed file then readable
obligations.observation: sync status; nothing committed; later load

obligations.text: Sync applies class, include, routine, .LOC and .DFI files; Global, FileCopy and WebApplication edits are left unapplied.

obligations.gap: No model represents sync output. The -verbose naming and the reload suggestion in Pipeline.cls::Run are unmodeled. The contrast is a verbose vs default run over an edited FileCopy resource.

obligations.text: Sync looks for a resource's files only in {SourcesRoot}/{Directory}, where Directory defaults to the file type.
obligations.cases: declared Directory vs defaulted Directory (e.g. cls) vs file elsewhere
obligations.gap: Conventional layout is an input Boolean. The Directory default (file type) and a custom Directory are not derived from Document.cls::GetSyncDirectory/OnItemRelativePath.

obligations.text: load -skip-sync leaves recording the hashes to the next sync.

obligations.observation: baseline rows after load and after the next sync

obligations.cases: outside-sync failure then exact revert vs sync failure then revert

obligations.text: A test failure after successful sync activation happens after the hash commit and does not undo it.
obligations.cases: tests pass vs fail after a successful load/compile

obligations.gap: No model of Main.cls::Sync's loop status. sync_summary.rs covers only skipped-test rows. The contrast is a whole-namespace sync where one module fails: the status (OK vs error) and the per-module failure lines plus summary. Open question devtools.sync.aggregate-status-policy.

obligations.text: Working assumption: files that a failed compile, load -dev or reload put on the server are re-detected by the next sync.
obligations.cases: outside-sync failure with disk still edited vs exact revert to baseline
obligations.observation: whether the next sync detects and reloads

obligations.text: The other resources are still compiled; if no resource is left to compile, no compile runs.

obligations.gap: Neither model holds compiled-code state, so the stale dependents and old code of the left-out resource are not represented. obligations.text: The warning is always printed; a whole-namespace sync keeps it in its final summary and a single-module sync does not.

obligations.gap: Only the author License/CopyrightDate routing is modeled. Name, version, description, keywords and the other author answers flow through NewTemplate/SetAuthorProps unmodeled.

obligations.text: Interactive generate writes source resources grouped by package.
Interactive generate writes test classes as UnitTest entries.

obligations.gap: ModuleTemplate.cls::AddDependant is unmodeled (native iter53 t2 only). Contrast: answer name:version yields that ModuleReference, and a malformed answer yields none or an error.

obligations.text: As built (C:D54), with -author the License and Copyright Date answers are stored in each other's fields.
obligations.cases: license != copyright answers

obligations.text: -export exports classes matching the mask prefix, excluding those under the ignore prefix, into the source folder.
obligations.cases: class under mask vs under ignore vs outside mask

obligations.cases: ignored routine; routine with mask as infix

obligations.text: Exported items are exported first and then become resources of the generated manifest.
obligations.cases: exported routine vs not exported
obligations.gap: iter53 exported() decides which items are exported, and iter69 grouping.rs decides how files in the source folder become resources. The step between them is unmodeled: ExportOneResource's file placement (classes in package folders under cls/, routines flat under mac/). Native iter53 t3 shows the exported routine written as G53E.Rout.MAC without a Directory (the C:D73 pattern). The export-to-load round trip has no committed receipt.

obligations.text: import loads class files and compiles them; a directory is searched recursively unless -norecurse; -nocompile loads without compiling.
obligations.cases: subdirectory item with/without -norecurse; -nocompile

obligations.cases: notification before load vs after

obligations.text: module-version changes the version in the stored manifest and the installed record together, or changes neither.
obligations.cases: success vs failure of checkout, save or manifest rewrite after the record is set
obligations.gap: All-or-nothing is assumed by the spec (state s unless ok). No theorem or control exercises a failure after the record save (Main.cls:4011-4099 transaction rollback), and the rollback was not run natively. Contrast: UpdateVersion fails after the record save, and both versions must read the old value.

obligations.text: major, minor and patch bump that part and reset later parts; -prerelease and -build then set those parts.

obligations.text: A version that is not higher than the current one is refused unless -force is given.

obligations.cases: request for current version without -force

obligations.text: The module.xml file the module was loaded from is not changed (whether it should be is open).

obligations.text: generate keeps classes under the chosen tests folder out of application resources, even when that folder is inside the source folder.

obligations.text: A missing source folder fails before resources are added, and no module.xml is written.

obligations.observation: error status; no resources; module.xml absent

obligations.text: A missing tests folder adds no tests.
obligations.cases: tests folder exists vs missing

obligations.text: Files with unsupported extensions, and files whose class or routine name cannot be read, are skipped; a class whose name can be read is listed even if its body does not compile (whether invalid source should fail is open).

obligations.text: Working assumption: generation skips an invalid source file and may produce a manifest without it.

obligations.note: Controls directory-only-key and top-level-only-key are rejected.

obligations.text: As built (C:D73), load cannot find a class without a package in the source folder when a cls folder also exists, or a class file named with dots outside package folders, so the load fails.
